name: Manfu Futou 3 Fallen Fighter
source:
Kan* is admired as the strongest fighter of martial arts in Kanto.

However after his weak point is discovered and his Lord Liu B*i is taken captive, he must give himself instead to have his lords safe return. He then offers himseld up to Ca*Ca*.

Ca*Ca* warmly recieves him and Y*n M*ng assists as well...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ043594.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
关*被誉为关东最强的武术家。

然而，当他的弱点被发现，他的主刘备被俘虏后，他必须牺牲自己，才能让他的主人们平安归来。然后他向Ca*Ca* 提出了自己的要求。

Ca*Ca*热情接待，Y*n M*ng也助攻……
